primary.title: Same mutual fund category, different capital gains tax? How a scheme's portfolio can change your tax bill
primary.summary: Mutual fund investors cannot always rely on a scheme’s category to determine capital gains tax. The actual portfolio allocation and tax classification can change the holding-period threshold and tax rate. Here’s what investors should check before redeeming.
